name: The Grumpy Turtle Protocol
format_rules: DEATH BY… — Minute 1: 1 rep. Minute 2: 2 reps. Minute 3: 3 reps… Alternate the two moves each minute. Rest whatever's left of each minute. When you can't finish inside the minute, you're out — write down the minute. Cap 14 min. Then do the finisher.
twist: PLANK TAX: every time you pause mid-workout to check your phone, pay 10 seconds of plank.

warmup.cue: Hold the wall, swing each leg forward and back.
Interlace fingers, roll wrists in circles.
Lunge, elbow to instep, rotate arm to ceiling.

main.cue: Sit on edge, lean back, pull knees in and extend out.
Step back to plank, step in, stand and reach. Quiet version.
Step one foot out while arms go up. Alternate. No jumping.

cooldown.cue: Lie down, 4 s in, 6 s out. You did it.
On your back, drop both knees to one side.
Knees wide, sit back, arms long.
Forearm on wall, turn your body away.
